title: Senior Content Designer
description: About Us: Moniepoint Group is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial ecosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed. At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts, bank integration, payment gateway, etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses. About this role: As a Senior Content Designer, you take ownership of the quality and strategic direction of content across your squad or product area. You bring expert content design judgment, deep user insight, and a collaborative mindset to shape product experiences that are clear, inclusive, and emotionally engaging. You support junior content designers, influence cross-team content strategy, and play a vital role in driving alignment across product, design, and engineering. You display an exceptional grasp of design thinking and content design expertise and are comfortable delivering well-thought out ideas to senior stakeholders and driving content design strategy each day.  What you’ll do  You are responsible for end-to-end content design strategy and execution on a project, from discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration. Partnering closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to embed content strategy in product discovery and delivery, shaping scope, trade-offs, and sequencing. Define for exceptional, accessible, and inclusive content that builds trust, clarity, and meaningful user engagement. Comfortable wireframing and prototyping and delivering your work in Figma, with clear rationale, adhering to a design systems and content design principles. Define content design strategy that aligns with business objectives and technical feasibility, ensuring content is not just clear but emotionally intelligent and on brand. Craft high-quality content for complex product flows, interface text, microcopy, error messaging, help content, and documentation, setting the bar for tone, clarity, and consistency. Take a strong role in qualitative and quantitative research methods (user interviews, usability tests, A/B experiments, content audits, analytics) using insight as a core design input. Collaborate deeply, proactively shaping product direction, surfacing trade-offs, and influencing delivery approaches. Drive the evolution of content design style guides, working closely with brand, marketing, and communications teams. Design thoughtful content that enhances usability, emotional impact, and user satisfaction. Balance speed and rigour with strong judgment on when to ship versus polish, especially on complex or fast-moving environments. Support junior content designers on the team and supports in terms of stakeholder management.  Lead alignment and collaboration across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating content design rationale and facilitating strategic working sessions. Set a high standard for product teams, fostering a culture of sound content design practices, constructive feedback, and shared accountability. You are able to justify content design decisions to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and delivers work in a standardised format that you help to evolve. You are able to deliver multiple variations, informed by insights and can confidently explain the pros and cons of particular solutions. What you need to succeed 5+ years of experience working as a content designer.  You are incredibly comfortable with the design aspect of content design – understanding this role is deeper than 'just words'. Strong stakeholder management skills are a must for this role.  You must be able to work in a fast-changing environment where processes are still being defined.  Exceptional knowledge of content design principles and end-to-end product thinking.  Experience with A/B testing, UX metrics, and data interpretation and the ability to drive your own research initiatives.  Exceptional product intuition - understanding user needs, business constraints, and technical feasibility. Good knowledge of Figma - how to collaborate, create prototypes, and work to produce agile solutions quickly, with little to no help.  Experience using AI a plus. Great if you’ve built workflows/tools using AI.  Excellent knowledge of working in cross-functional teams. Able to advocate for content design across various company areas and embed content design early in product planning.  Actively contributes to a content design system, creating reusable patterns and components   Experience in fintech or SaaS environments is a strong advantage. Strong communication skills - able to explain the “why” behind your decisions  Strong stakeholder management is a must for this role  Recruitment Process Application & portfolio review - we’re looking for exceptional content design case studies, showing examples of end-to-end product thinking, driven by research and illustrating impact.  Recruiter conversation - light intro on your background, team experience, and motivations. Leadership interview - deep dive into your skills and expertise with the lead content designer.  Content design task and portfolio presentation - a short task to assess how you approach content design and you’ll present a case study from your portfolio Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Credit Underwriter
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role Senior Credit Underwriter will underwrite all SME, Mid-Corporate and Large Corporate lending applications that require manual underwriting within the Industry Sector.  You will also be responsible for ensuring lending remains within Risk Appetite and that performance is maintained within agreed target loan loss levels. In addition, you will work with the Head of Credit Risk Analytics and Chief Risk Officer to continually assess and define lending thresholds and parameters to ensure a balanced risk-based approach that also supports business growth objectives. Reporting to the Head of Credit Risk Analytics you will also be expected to continually innovate and identify areas of risk and opportunity within your portfolio, leveraging key data sources and indicators, whilst also leveraging your subjective matter expertise to ensure effective on-going credit risk management of the portfolio. You will also work closely with a range of business partners, including Sales, Product and Data Engineering teams to support new strategic product initiatives to drive the growth objectives of the business. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Key Responsibilities  Education and adoption of best practices in credit analysis, underwriting and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, right from early lending discussions with Sales teams to the development of credit approval memos for senior management and/or risk committee approval forums.. Detailed review and due diligence of lending applications, including financial analysis, business projection modelling and viability, stress testing and other in-depth analysis required to support the sanctioning of large-ticket loans. Responsible for the monitoring and portfolio health of the sector and conducting regular credit reviews and ad-hoc deep-dives to continually assess portfolio performance. Drive positive change in the maturity of the underwriting framework and strategy.. Continual interaction with a broad range of functions and stakeholders to drive credit risk maturity across the business. Facilitating Risk initiatives and pilots by reviewing credit data. Conducting periodic reviews of individual bad debts. Requirements Significant experience underwriting SME and Large Corporate loans likely gained from a leading Financial Institution within Nigeria and primarily for businesses within the financial industry sector (must have). Highly experienced in the end-to-end underwriting process for large ticket loans up to 5Bn NGN (must have). Expert in the financial assessment of SME and Large Corporates using a broad range of data sources (e.g. Financials, Audited Accounts and Bank Statements etc.). Expert in understanding headwinds and opportunities within the industry sector and must have detailed knowledge of macroeconomic and regulatory factors impacting this sector. Experienced in the assessment of collateral and covenants to mitigate risk across secured and unsecured lending.
